# Patch set v3 (2026-11-11): local publication candidates. Nothing is published.

**Status.** Generated and checked locally. Not committed, not pushed, no pull request. Each unit is blocked by the approval named in `../11_proposed_changes_and_blockers.md`.

**Base for every patch.** `5c82d37` on branch `stage7-payments` (the same commit as origin/stage7-payments). Generated by `make_patches.sh`: tracked files with `git diff`, new files with `git diff --no-index` (exit status 1 on differences is expected). Base export `base_5c82d37.tar`: sha256 `0e79bc8f6d23e1b668aef5becf01d40a9b2a4b1c9334ab6c899ecbeb0035f6f9`.

## 3. Verification

Dependency matrix, run 2026-11-11 on the final P4 (`logs_2026-11-11/matrix_v3_rev2_summary.txt`):

| Case | Patches | Admin (`npm test`) | Web (`npm test`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | P3 alone | 23 of 27 (4 of 7 files fail to load: ENOENT on the migration paths) | 163 of 163 |
| M2 | P4 alone | not applicable | 212 of 212 |
| M3 | P2, P3 | 72 of 72 | 163 of 163 |
| M4 | P2, P4 | not applicable | 212 of 212 |
| M5 | P3, P4 | 23 of 27 (as M1) | 212 of 212 |
| M6 | P1, P2, P3, P4 | 72 of 72 | 212 of 212 |
| M7 | P2 alone | applies cleanly; no npm test covers it | not applicable |

Browser check, licence screen: `logs_2026-11-11/licence_smoke_v3rev2_M6.log`: **33 of 33** on the M6 tree with the final P4, served by `python3 -m http.server 5174` from the M6 `web/` folder. `CHROMIUM_PATH` was unset, so Playwright's own browser was used. The earlier run (`licence_smoke_v3_M6.log`, before the `CHROMIUM_PATH` change) also gave 33 of 33 and is superseded.

Not run for this set: `owner-smoke.cjs`, `stats-smoke.cjs`, `features-smoke.cjs`, `qr-smoke.cjs`. No saved logs exist for them in this set (see the regression row in `docs/STAGE7E_LICENCE_STATUS.md`).
